facts.fact: StackAdapt states that audio companion banners are clickable visual ads displayed for the duration of the audio ad they accompany.
facts.quote: Audio companion ads or audio companion banners are clickable visual ads that run at the same time as an audio ad. They are displayed for the duration of the ad

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that audio companion banners provide an added metric on top of the usual audio metrics, namely clicks.
facts.quote: audio companion banners provide an added metric on top of the usual audio metrics: clicks.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that companion banners depend on the publisher's player capabilities and are not necessarily displayed in all players.
facts.quote: companion banners do depend on the publisher’s player capabilities and are not necessarily displayed in all players.
